Scene begins from the attached reference frame. Keep Daehan anchored to the FAR RIGHT 22% of the frame; only his right arm may extend leftward during pointing, and ONLY his gloved hand crosses into the board area — his body stays right. Medium shot, eye-level, 16:9 widescreen. STRICT FRAMING: Daehan is shifted all the way to the RIGHT EDGE of the frame, occupying ONLY the right 22%. His left shoulder sits roughly at horizontal 78% of the image. The LEFT 78% is an unobstructed EMPTY green chalkboard reserved for post-production typography — nothing (not the character, not any prop) may intrude into that area beyond its rightmost 2%. Do NOT render any text, letters, numbers, chalk marks, scroll props, or writing anywhere in the frame.
